answer: Each agent identity must post a bond that is slashed on misbehavior, and a fresh key cannot reach that ledge on its own: a few peers who already hold stake must attest it after a slow review cycle. A Sybil farm cannot spin up ten thousand keys, since every one needs an independent vouching chain and capital locked for months. Attackers must wander through the same queue as everyone else, and the cost of a manufactured fleet grows with each fake identity until it outruns any reward. At dawn the settlement round also flags clusters that only interact with themselves.
